Definition: Jiphtach, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Jephthah is the judge of Gilead who vowed a vow before the battle with Ammon, and the name of a town in Judah. In Joshua 15:43, Jiphtah, and Ashnah. The fuller story is told on the Jephthah, Judge of Israel profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jephthah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
